boundary: all immediate incoming cell pins and their immediate wire drivers; no recursive expansion
physical_assumptions: Certified unchanged AES R0 DEF, original extracted scene SPEFs and Liberty; no edits to cells, constraints, RC, clocks or backend; same reference operating points, not finite differences.
coverage_contract: All incoming arcs and rise/fall max tags in the declared bounded fanin; both native data transitions at both setup endpoints; every native combinational incoming arc/transition at both drivers. Missing native compatibility oracle, unknown required validity, conditional ambiguity, truncation, unmatched samples or missing model input keep the corresponding check unpassed.
